comingLast.roast: level pegging with Denholm - the countback rules are being googled at the bar
tied at the bottom with Macintosh - back nines will decide who takes them home
in on a 2-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
in with a 2-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
his round is over, his sweating is not - 2 above the line
in the clubhouse 2 above Macintosh - cheering for him from a safe distance
done and 3 above the drop - his interest in Macintosh's round is intense and personal
in the clubhouse 3 above Macintosh - cheering for him from a safe distance
4 above Macintosh from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
finished 4 above the blue line - toasting every point Macintosh does not score
